info.name: Shop API — Auth + Catalog
info.description:
Sanctum token auth + catalog/orders. Docker `base_url=http://localhost:84`. Local XAMPP `base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000`.

Use **View → Show description** (or the Docs panel) on each request to see param spelling, type, required/optional, and example values.

## Spelling (use these exact keys)

Do **not** send `category_id` on create/update product. Use **`category_ids`** (plural array).
Do **not** send `tag_ids`. This API has no tags.

| Key | Type | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | string (email) | login / register body |
| `password` | string | login / register body |
| `password_confirmation` | string | register body |
| `name` | string | register / category / product body |
| `slug` | string | category / product body (optional) |
| `description` | string | category / product body (optional) |
| `is_active` | boolean (`true`/`false` or `1`/`0`) | list query + category/product body |
| `page` | integer ≥ 1 | list query |
| `per_page` | integer 1–50 | list query |
| `sort` | string (column name) | list query |
| `sort_direction` | string (`asc` or `desc`) | list query |
| `search` | string | list query |
| `category_id` | integer | **product list filter only** |
| `min_price` / `max_price` | number | product list query |
| `sku` | string | product body |
| `price` | number ≥ 0 | product body |
| `stock` | integer ≥ 0 | product body |
| `category_ids` | array of integers | product create/update/sync body |
| `image` | file jpg/jpeg/png/webp, max 2MB | product form-data |
| `remove_image` | boolean | product update form-data |
| `items` | array | order body |
| `items[].product_id` | integer | order body |
| `items[].quantity` | integer 1–100 | order body |

Header on protected routes: `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` + `Accept: application/json`.

Public. Creates a customer + empty profile. Role cannot be sent (always customer).

**Body (JSON)**

| Param | Type | Required | Rules | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | max 255 | `New Customer` |
| `email` | string (email) | yes | unique | `new@shop.test` |
| `password` | string | yes | min 8, mixed case, number, symbol | `Shop@1234` |
| `password_confirmation` | string | yes | must match `password` | `Shop@1234` |
Auth required. No query/body params. Returns the logged-in user + profile.

Auth required. Updates the logged-in user's profile (shipping address, phone, bio). Send only fields you want to change.

**Body (JSON) — all optional**

| Param | Type | Max | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phone` | string | 30 | `+919876543210` |
| `bio` | string | — | `Laravel developer` |
| `line1` | string | 255 | `123 Main Street` |
| `line2` | string | 255 | `Apt 4B` |
| `city` | string | 80 | `Indore` |
| `state` | string | 80 | `MP` |
| `postal_code` | string | 20 | `452001` |
| `country` | string | 2 | `IN` |

**Required for placing orders:** `line1`, `city`, `postal_code`, `country`.
Auth required. No query/body params. Deletes the current Sanctum token.

request.description:
Admin + Bearer token. Use **form-data** (not raw JSON) if sending an image.

**Body**

| Param | Type | Required | Rules | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **yes** | max 160 | `Demo Mouse` |
| `sku` | string | **yes** | max 60, unique | `MSE-AUTH-01` |
| `slug` | string | no | max 180, unique; auto from name | `demo-mouse` |
| `description` | string | no | | `Wireless mouse` |
| `price` | number | **yes** | ≥ 0 | `799` |
| `stock` | integer | **yes** | ≥ 0 | `25` |
| `is_active` | boolean | no | default true | `1` |
| `category_ids` | array of integers | **yes** | min 1, each must exist | `category_ids[0]=1` |
| `image` | file | no | jpg/jpeg/png/webp, max 2MB | pick a file |

Wrong: `category_id`, `tag_ids`.
Right: `category_ids`.

Customer + Bearer token. Shipping address is copied from the user profile (seeded for `customer@shop.test`).

**Body (JSON)**

| Param | Type | Required | Rules | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array | **yes** | min 1 item | see below |
| `items[].product_id` | integer | **yes** | must exist in `products.id` | `1` |
| `items[].quantity` | integer | **yes** | 1–100 | `2` |

Example:
```json
{
  "items": [
    { "product_id": 1, "quantity": 1 },
    { "product_id": 2, "quantity": 2 }
  ]
}
```

Auth required. Customer sees own orders; admin sees all.
